original_question: For a nonsingular projective 3-fold X, establish the conjectural equivalence between Gromov-Witten curve counting and Donaldson-Thomas curve counting, i.e., prove the GW/DT correspondence for 3-folds.
target_in_paper: Section (iii) On the moduli of sheaves, Q4: Prove the GW/DT correspondence for 3-folds.
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper's target problem very closely: it concerns a nonsingular projective 3-fold X and asks for the Gromov–Witten/Donaldson–Thomas correspondence, understood as a conjectural equivalence between GW curve counting and DT curve counting.
missing_details: The paper states this as Q4 in section (iii), so it is framed as an open problem in the note, not as a theorem proved there.
The Gromov–Witten side is specifically the Gromov–Witten theory of X defined via the moduli spaces M_g(X, β) of stable maps.
The Donaldson–Thomas side is specifically the theory defined via moduli of ideal sheaves of curves in X; the paper also notes the more recent stable-pairs viewpoint.
The note's ambient algebraic setting is over C, although Q4 itself does not restate the base field.

The scope is the full theory of an arbitrary nonsingular projective 3-fold, implicitly ranging over genera g and curve classes β, not just a fixed genus, fixed class, Calabi–Yau case, or local/toric example.
The exact formal meaning of 'equivalent' is not unpacked in this short note; the paper refers to [15] for the precise GW/DT correspondence formalism.
The nearby context records that toric cases are already known, so the intended open problem is the general 3-fold case beyond toric geometry.
refined_question: For every nonsingular projective 3-fold X over C, prove that the full Gromov–Witten theory of X—defined via the moduli spaces M_g(X, β) of stable maps, for all genera g and curve classes β—is equivalent to the Donaldson–Thomas theory of X defined via moduli of ideal sheaves of curves in X, thereby establishing the GW/DT correspondence for arbitrary 3-folds beyond the already known toric cases.
justification: This is the nearest official formulation in the paper. In section (iii), after introducing a nonsingular projective 3-fold X and stating that its Gromov–Witten theory is conjecturally equivalent to its Donaldson–Thomas theory, the note asks exactly Q4: Prove the GW/DT correspondence for 3-folds. The refined version only makes explicit the moduli-theoretic definitions and the full-theory quantifiers that are implicit in the paper's wording, while avoiding broader neighboring problems such as Q5 on defining Donaldson–Thomas invariants in dimensions greater than 3.
